CreateInstance.summary: Creates a Hologres instance in the specified region.

regionId.description: The region ID. For more information, see <props="china">[Endpoints](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props><props="intl">[Endpoints](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props>.

vpcId.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). The VPC must be in the same region as the instance.

vSwitchId.description: The ID of the vSwitch. The vSwitch must be in the same zone as the instance.

resourceGroupId.description: The resource group. If you leave this parameter empty, the default resource group for your account is used.

instanceName.description: The instance name. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. A letter is counted as one character.

instanceType.description:
The instance type. Valid values:

- Standard: General-purpose instance.

- Follower: Read-only secondary instance.

- Warehouse: Virtual warehouse instance.

- Shared: Shared instance.

- Serverless: Serverless instance.

cpu.description:
The instance type. Valid values:

- 32 vCPUs and 128 GB of memory (2 compute nodes)

- 64 vCPUs and 256 GB of memory (4 compute nodes)

- 96 vCPUs and 384 GB of memory (6 compute nodes)

- 128 vCPUs and 512 GB of memory (8 compute nodes)

- and so on.

> * Specify the number of vCPUs.
>
> * To purchase an instance with more than 1,024 vCPUs, submit a ticket.
>
> * You do not need to specify the instance type for a shared instance.

storageSize.description:
The standard storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB.

> This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go (PostPaid) instances.

coldStorageSize.description:
The cold storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB.

> This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go (PostPaid) instances.

gatewayCount.description:
The number of gateways. Valid values: \[2, 50].

> You must specify this parameter only for virtual warehouse instances.

chargeType.description:
The billing method. Valid values:

- PrePaid: Subscription.

- PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go.

> This parameter is ignored for shared instances. Shared instances use defined specifications and the default billing method is pay-as-you-go..

autoPay.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

- true (default): Automatic payment is enabled.

- false: An order is generated, but no payment is made.

> If your account balance is insufficient, set the `autoPay` parameter to `false`. When an unpaid order is generated, log on to the Expenses and Costs console to pay for the order.

pricingCycle.description:
The billing cycle. Valid values:

- Month: The instance is billed on a monthly basis.

- Hour: The instance is billed on an hourly basis.

> * Subscription instances support only `Month`.
>
> * Pay-as-you-go instances support only `Hour`.
>
> * For shared instances, the value is automatically set to `Hour`.

enumValueTitles.Month: The instance is billed on a monthly basis.
enumValueTitles.Hour: The instance is billed on an hourly basis.

duration.description:
The subscription duration, such as two months.

> Specify this parameter only for subscription instances.

autoRenew.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- true: Auto-renewal is enabled.

- false (default): Auto-renewal is disabled.

leaderInstanceId.description:
The ID of the primary instance. This parameter is required for secondary instances.

> The primary and secondary instances must meet the following conditions:
>
> - The primary instance is in the Running state.
>
> - The primary and secondary instances are in the same region and zone.
>
> - They are in the same zone.
>
> - The primary instance has less than 10 secondary instances.
>
> - The primary and secondary instances belong to the same Alibaba Cloud account.

enableServerlessComputing.description: Specifies whether to enable Serverless Computing.

Data.description: The returned results.

Success.description:
Indicates whether the instance was created.

- true: The instance was created.

- false: The instance failed to be created.


BackupType.description:
The backup type.

- redundant: Stores instance snapshots across zones within the same region.

- redundant\_remote: Stores instance snapshots across zones in a different region.

- full: Stores an instance snapshot locally.

- full\_remote: Stores an instance snapshot remotely.

- local: It is a filter for local snapshots, not a backup type.

- remote: It is a filter for remote snapshots, not a backup type.

StartTime.description: The timestamp when the backup began. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSTZ` (UTC+8). This format is used for all time-related parameters.

DataDesc.description: The description of the snapshot. It can be updated.

DataTime.description: The time when the data snapshot was created. For the format, see StartTime.

DataSize.description: The size of the snapshot, in bytes.

EndTime.description: The time when the backup was completed. For the format, see StartTime.

ColdDataSize.description: The size of the cold data, in bytes.

InstanceRegion.description: The region where the instance resides.

SnapshotRegion.description: The region where the snapshot is stored.

InstanceZoneId.description: The zone where the instance resides.

SnapshotZoneId.description: The zone where backup snapshot(s). If you use zone-redundant storage, the data is stored across multiple zones. This parameter returns one of those zones.

ScaleInstance.summary: Changes the specifications and storage space of a Hologres instance.

cpu.description:
The instance specifications. Valid values:

- `16`: 16 vCPUs and 64 GB of memory (1 compute node)

- `32`: 32 vCPUs and 128 GB of memory (2 compute nodes)

- `64`: 64 vCPUs and 256 GB of memory (4 compute nodes)

- `96`: 96 vCPUs and 384 GB memory (6 compute nodes)

- `128`: 128 vCPUs and 512 GB memory (8 compute nodes)

- and so on.

> * Specify the number of vCPUs.
>
> * To purchase an instance type with more than 1024 vCPUs, submit a ticket.
>
> * Skip this parameter for shared instances.

storageSize.description:
The standard storage space of the instance. Unit: GB.

> This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go instances.

coldStorageSize.description:
The cold storage space of the instance. Unit: GB.

> This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go instances.

scaleType.description:
The scaling type.

- UPGRADE: Upgrades the instance.

- DOWNGRADE: Downgrades the instance.

> * **Upgrade an instance:** New specifications must be equal to or greater than original specifications. Leaving a parameter empty retains its original specification. At least one specification must be increased.
>
> * **Downgrade an instance:** New specifications must be equal to or less than original specifications. Leaving a parameter empty retains its original specification. At least one specification must be decreased.

gatewayCount.description:
The number of gateways. Valid values: \[2, 50].

> This parameter applies only to virtual warehouse instances.

enableServerlessComputing.description: Specifies whether to enable Serverless Computing.

Data.description: The returned results.

Success.description: Indicates whether the scaling was successful.
